verdict.rationale: The evidence shows recurring subscription billing with weekly, monthly or yearly frequency and automatic payment retries. That is a domain-specific recurring charge, not a user-definable capability to schedule arbitrary jobs or workflows. No scheduler, cron, or workflow-scheduling feature is documented in the MCP server, CLI or APIs, so the subscription feature counts only as adjacent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
